patch.value: Scorecard alert 29: patch Axios in the CodSpeed development dependency graph

Live Scorecard alert 29 on main 89b4aa8bb4d9fd4ece4e9865905929d41cc84515 is open: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/security/code-scanning/29. The October 2 all-dependency pnpm audit reports 7 high and 5 moderate Axios advisories; production audit reports zero. The sole locked Axios 1.19.0 is reached through @codspeed/vitest-plugin 5.7.1 -> @codspeed/core 5.7.1, and every reported advisory is patched by Axios >=1.20.0. Separately, both published CodSpeed core CJS and ESM bundles contain embedded Axios 1.4.0; a lockfile-only override cannot remove that bundled copy. The Mongo instrumentation path is controlled by CODSPEED_MONGO_INSTR_SERVER_ADDRESS and is not configured by this repository normal benchmark workflow; no production CLI Axios use or present exploit is established. Preserve mandatory CodSpeed benchmarking and its runtime contracts while correcting the dependency and bundled source. The current mandatory Trivy filesystem scan excludes development dependencies, while standalone secret scanning does not detect vulnerable dependency versions. Add real dev-inclusive admission and negative controls in required CI/nightly/release/local gates without skip or threshold relaxation.
